messages:
Maya (CS): Quick sync — just finished onboarding call with Nora at Crescent Labs. captured 3 product asks + one operational risk. dropping notes here for prioritization.

Maya (CS): 1) Admin UI: need per-team routing rules for model variants (they want to route research vs prod traffic). current workaround is manual. ask: config + exportable JSON.

Maya (CS): 2) Cost visibility: they want per-route token breakouts in billing export (CSV) — granular enough to match their internal chargeback (team/project).

Maya (CS): 3) Onboarding smoothness: examples/recipes for model pinning + canary rollouts — Nora said docs are a bit abstract; wants a 15-min runbook.

Maya (CS): Risk: renewal flagged — they hit a spike and saw a fallback to a cheaper variant once, which affected latency. worried about SLA.

Nora (Crescent Labs): thanks Maya. +1 on the per-route billing CSV. the fallback incident is big — need clearer rollout controls. we can commit if those two are addressed.

Diego (PM): thanks for the notes. quick questions: for routing rules, do they need UI-only or API-first? Nora: API-first, but UI is fine to start.

Nora (Crescent Labs): API-first. want to script rules in infra. UI helpful for admins.

Lina (Enablement): I can build a 15-min runbook + a short demo recording for model pinning/canary. timeline: 3 business days.

Jared (Product Ops): Noted on billing CSV. We already have token-level tracking internally, but export needs per-route tags. Diego — can we treat this as a small data-export feature? estimate 1 sprint backend + lp on export formatting.

Diego (PM): sounds reasonable. Prioritization proposal: (A) Billing CSV per-route (B) Routing rules API + UI (C) Runbook/demo. A is sticky for finance; B for reliability. any objections?

Maya (CS): @Diego agree. but note customer wants routing rules asap to avoid more fallbacks. could we do a minimal API endpoint that sets 'pin' + 'fallback-disable' flags? even if full rule engine comes later.

Diego (PM): that's a good incremental approach. Jared — can ops support a 'pin' flag and a boolean to disable fallback per-customer?

Jared (Product Ops): yes, we can add a per-tenant override for fallback behavior. low-risk toggle, roll out behind a feature flag. estimate: 3-4 days to implement and verify.

Maya (CS): Perfect. Lina — after runbook is live can you include a short snippet showing the pin toggle and where it is in UI/API? that will help Nora validate.

Lina (Enablement): Will do. I'll draft the runbook and a 7min screen recording. tagging content in the knowledge base.

Diego (PM): Next steps: Jared to spin feature flag PR for fallback-override (due EOD Thu), Jared to open ticket for per-route billing export (sizing + schema) by Fri, Lina to deliver runbook + recording by next Wed. Maya will coordinate Crescent Labs validation.

redwood-bot: Reminder: please add the new tickets to the CS->Product intake board and set "Crescent Labs" as customer tag.

Maya (CS): added to intake board. I'll ping again after Nora tests the pin toggle. :thumbsup:

Nora (Crescent Labs): thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Diego (PM): thanks all. I'll follow up in the product backlog thread with ticket links.

Maya (CS): closing loop here. will post updates as they come.
